description: This file defines an interface class GatekeeperChannel for communication channels that handle Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It declares methods for sending requests and responses and for receiving messages, serving as an abstraction for synchronous communication channels related to Gatekeeper services.

classes.name: GatekeeperChannel
classes.description: An interface class for communication channels that facilitate synchronous Gatekeeper IPC/RPC communication.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command identifier and a GateKeeperMessage payload.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command identifier and a GateKeeperMessage payload.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the transport layer, returning a ManagedMessage instance.
